title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Itawes Agricultural College in the Municipality of Piat, Province of Cagayan, to the Northern Luzon State College of Agriculture
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Itawes Agricultural College in the Municipality of Piat, Province of Cagayan, to the Northern Luzon State College of Agriculture
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Itawes Agricultural College tại Thị trấn Piat, Tỉnh Cagayan thành Northern Luzon State College of Agriculture
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Itawes Agricultural College ในเทศบาล Piat, จังหวัด Cagayan เป็น Northern Luzon State College of Agriculture
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Itawes Agricultural College di Kotamadya Piat, Provinsi Cagayan menjadi Northern Luzon State College of Agriculture
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Itawes Agricultural College di Perbandaran Piat, Wilayah Cagayan menjadi Northern Luzon State College of Agriculture

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_4893_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Itawes Agricultural College in the Municipality of Piat, Province of Cagayan, is hereby changed to the Northern Luzon State College of Agriculture.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
